question: What does the Autel EVO Max 4N do when the control link is lost, and do incident reports match?

intake.focus: Autel EVO Max 4N lost control link behavior
intake.reason: Question about what the Autel EVO Max 4N does when the control link is lost and whether incident reports align with guidance/manuals.

brief.short_answer: FAA guidance: reestablish the control link if possible, and discontinue flight or avoid further operations if the link cannot be reestablished. Autel EVO Max 4N manual: the drone enters a reconnection state and, if reconnected within 10 seconds, control returns automatically; if not, a warning is shown and a preset Signal Loss Action is executed, with RTH attempting to reconnect. Incident reports (unverified): claims of loss of control, continued flight away, failed Return To Home, and the UAS not being located. Gap/conflict: FAA favors discontinue or emergency procedures; Autel describes automatic signal-loss actions and possible continued RTH/hover behavior, with unclear verbatim transfer conditions and limited documented settings in the incident reports.

claims.quote: If connection cannot be reestablished, start emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link.

claims.quote: Discontinue flight and/or avoid further flight operations until further inspection and testing of the control link between the ground control unit and the aircraft.

testing and inspection before further flight

claims.text: When the C2 link is lost, the drone will enter a reconnection state and continuously attempt to re-establish connection with the ground control station.
claims.quote: The drone will enter a reconnection state when the C2 (Command & Control) link is lost, continuously attempting to re- establish connection with the ground control station (e.g., the remote controller).

claims.text: If the link is restored within 10 seconds after disconnection, control will automatically return to the remote controller.
claims.quote: If the link is restored within 10 seconds after disconnection, control will automatically return to the remote controller.

claims.text: If reconnection is not established within 10 seconds, the Autel Enterprise App will display the warning message 'Aircraft disconnected,' and the drone will execute the preset Signal Loss Action or Signal Lost behavior accordingly.
claims.quote: If reconnection is not established within 10 seconds, the Autel Enterprise App will display the warning message “Aircraft disconnected.”, and the drone will execute the preset Signal Loss Action or Signal Lost behavior accordingly.

claims.text: During the execution of automatic RTH caused by signal loss, the drone will continue to attempt to reconnect.
claims.quote: During the execution of automatic RTH caused by signal loss, the drone will continue to attempt to reconnect.
conditions: automatic RTH triggered by signal loss

claims.text: During manual flight, upon losing connection, the drone will slow down and hover, then execute the Signal Lost behavior after the corresponding disconnection message is shown in the app.
claims.quote: During manual flight, upon losing connection, the drone will slow down and hover. It will then execute the Signal Lost behavior after the corresponding disconnection message is shown in the app.

claims.quote: Shortly after takeoff I completely lost control of the UAS.
